scientific_limitations: Only finite generalized quadrangles of order (s,t) with s,t>=2 and unweighted shortest-path incidence metrics.
Only positive-dimensional barcode asserted; the degree-zero barcode is not included.
Finite exact replay covers the symplectic prime orders two and three; the all-order result rests on an independent symbolic proof.
Equivalent treatments in unindexed graph-power literature cannot be excluded from available comparisons.
